design.boundary: Typed pointer reading of ONE focus world as a small directed graph, on one teaching order. The held-back questions are about five course worlds the machine never read (same world sizes and question kinds as training); the development panel is out-of-distribution ten-node parts/reach. The primary label is keyed on the RELATIONAL tier, so gains on the DIRECT_READ kinds alone cannot produce it. No protected final-study, general CAS architecture, or full-machine claim.
design.owner_approval: 2026-09-19 owner decisions, verbatim, five of five: "Accept both, carry on." (both corrections -- the in-job checkpoint check costs about $0.38-0.63 per job, not "no extra cost", and pointer answers alone cannot work because the INPUT must change too, one world read as a graph instead of a blend of all 64), "Approve the smoke job (Recommended)" (a short AWS smoke job for S10, well under $1, before any paid launch), "Yes — require the relational kinds." (the primary label is keyed on the RELATIONAL tier; the all-kinds result is a reported flag, never the label), "Run it as the transfer test, label honestly (Recommended)" (the study runs as the transfer test it was built to be, and the label is printed honestly, so a tier or a kind whose answer is already in the input is reported as such and never carries a learning claim), and on the LB11 schedule question "Stratify AND train longer (Recommended)" (the single pass is stratified -- every one of the eight kinds in every update at the same 147 updates per pass -- and the pass count is the study's own parameter above the practice study's 10, so `STRATIFIED` is True and `MAX_PASSES_PERMITTED` is 24).
